1.title: Level 1 - Partner signals
1.blurb: Basics: reply vs volunteer, friendship vs shared load.

items.text: Someone who always answers within an hour, but never starts a thread or brings a next step, is already showing full partner-level proactiveness.
Replying carefully when asked can show integrity without proving they will volunteer risk or agenda on their own.
If the other person only ever sends 'sounds good' or 'thanks' after your long proposals, that pattern leans more tool-like than partner-like.
A warm friendship of many years is enough evidence that two people will share decision load equally in a company.
When one person invents every idea and the other only executes after being assigned, the second person is still at the top of the partner scale.
Proactiveness means bringing an idea, risk, or next step without waiting to be tapped - not merely answering faster.
Saying 'I am a partner type' in a coffee chat outweighs months of one-sided emails where only you follow up.
Division of labor can be uneven in skills and still be partnerable if both sides initiate and carry decisions in their lane.
Family relation automatically places both people high on the partner scale for a business venture.
If both sides start threads and propose next steps over months, that reciprocity weighs more than a single pep talk.

2.title: Level 2 - Pattern traps
2.blurb: Harder: burst vs steady, chase patterns, and false gold from personality labels.

items.text: A three-week burst of daily chat followed by six months of silence is stronger partner evidence than a quieter but steady six-month back-and-forth.
If you always chase replies and they never reopen an open loop, the chase pattern itself is evidence on the partner-to-tool scale.
Ghosting after early enthusiasm should be ignored if a personality quiz once labeled them collaborative.
Someone who pushes back with a dated counter-proposal is closer to partner behavior than someone who always agrees and then goes quiet.
Hard work on assigned tasks for a year proves equal partnerability even if they never propose direction.
A person who only works when assigned may still be a strong professional hire - that is not the same claim as equal partnerability.
One inspiring weekend workshop outweighs a year of one-sided follow-ups when judging partner lean.
When both people restart stalled topics without being asked, that habit is a stronger partner signal than polite availability alone.
If dated messages show only thank-you replies for months, treating that as full partner is justified by goodwill.
Initiative when tapped, without volunteering next moves, can still be honest professional behavior without being full partner lean.

3.title: Level 3 - Decision load & risk
3.blurb: Who carries hard calls, downside, and repair - not just cheerleading.

items.text: If only one person ever names the downside risk, and the other only cheers the upside, the cheerleading is still equal decision load.
A partner-leaning pattern includes bringing bad news early, not only celebrating wins.
Deferring every hard call to you because you are the visionary is a classic partner-equality marker.
Asking for a clear next owner and a dated check-in after a messy meeting is closer to partner behavior than waiting for you to chase.
If they only engage when money is about to change hands, that still proves day-to-day partnerability.
Shared calendars and written next steps after calls reduce the chance that one side silently drops the ball.
Saying you decide on every fork is the same as co-owning the outcome.
When they propose a disagree-and-commit path with a review date, that is stronger than endless polite agreement.
If they rewrite history of who agreed to what, dated messages matter more than memory of the coffee chat.
Equal equity paperwork alone proves equal day-to-day partner behavior in the message record.

4.title: Level 4 - Founder precedents
4.blurb: Traps from common co-founder and partner failure modes.

items.text: In many failed co-founder stories, one side kept being busy for the company while never initiating strategy - busyness alone should still score as partner gold.
A pattern of only critiquing your ideas without offering an alternative is closer to spectator behavior than partner behavior.
If they disappear during fundraising stress but return when the round closes, that timing is irrelevant to partner lean.
Repair after a conflict (named issue, plan, dated follow-through) is a stronger partner signal than never arguing.
Using family loyalty as a substitute for written next steps is a reliable way to prove equal partnerability.
When they bring an outside expert or note to help a stuck decision, that can be partner-leaning if they stay in the ownership loop.
If every yes arrives after you threaten to walk away, that still counts as free, steady partner initiative.
Precedent: teams that keep a shared written decision log tend to argue less about who promised what months later.
A long silence after you asked for a clear no is the same as a clear no.
Partnerability cares whether both sides reopen hard topics; professionalism alone can be one-sided and still look polite.

5.title: Level 5 - Wisdom edge cases
5.blurb: Subtle cases where manners and partner lean diverge.

items.text: Someone can be loyal, kind, and skilled as a contractor and still sit on the tool side of the partner scale.
If they always wait for your emotional weather before stating a preference, that proves they share agenda ownership.
Wisdom check: evidence of partner lean is cumulative dated behavior, not a single heroic weekend.
When they protect the venture's reputation in public but never carry private ops load, public praise equals private partnerability.
A clear, early I cannot own this lane is more partner-honest than a soft yes that later becomes silence.
If they only initiate when the idea flatters them, ignore that filter when scoring partner lean.
Precedent wisdom: unequal talk time in meetings is less important than unequal follow-through after the meeting.
Treating we will figure it out with no owner and no date as a closed decision is sound partner practice.
If dated records show they raised constraints you missed, that dissent can be partner-leaning even when uncomfortable.
After five levels of strong scores, you should stop watching future behavior because the past forever locks partner status.
